# Preface {.unnumbered}

bd-yjf99rzx: in `citation-location: margin` mode the book leaves citations
for Typst's native bibliography, which never sees front-matter
`references:`. The citation in the next chapter fails with Q-21-5 before
Typst runs. (Without margin mode the book's own citeproc pass resolves
inline references, so the plain case renders.)
